'''Tennōgū Ōtoshi Shrine''' (てんのうぐうおおとしじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in Tennō-chō, {{ill|Chūō-ku, Hamamatsu|fa|چو-کو، هاماماتسو|fr|Chūō-ku (Hamamatsu)|it|Chūō-ku (Hamamatsu)|ja|中央区 (浜松市)|ko|주오구 (하마마쓰시)|simple|Chūō-ku, Hamamatsu|tr|Chūō, Hamamatsu|zh|中央區 (濱松市)|qid=Q117084743|lt=Chūō Ward}}, {{ill|Hamamatsu|Q185125|qid=Q185125}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}. One of its component shrines, Ōtoshi Shrine, is listed among the {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Tōtōmi Province|Q11642130|qid=Q11642130|lt=Engishiki shrines}}.

=== History ===
The date of establishment is unknown.  
Originally, the shrine consisted of three separate shrines—{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tennōgū}}, Tennō Shrine, and {{ill|Ōtoshi Shrines|Q11436758|qid=Q11436758}}—which were later merged. Subsequently, the tutelary deities of four parish towns were also enshrined together, resulting in the present form.  
The collective name Tennōgū Ōtoshi Shrine came into use thereafter.

=== Other ===
* One of the shrine’s {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Gonnegi}} (assistant priests), who is also a motorcyclist, began providing support services for riders. This led to the shrine becoming known as a “Motorcycle Shrine.”<ref>[https://hamamatsu-lab.jp/goout/2327.html Published: 2021/10/04 “Ōtoshi Shrine, the Motorcycle Shrine of Hamamatsu, the Home of Motorcycles” Hamalabo – Hamamatsu Research Institute]</ref><ref>[https://forride.jp/motorcycle/sizuoka-touring Published: 2020/08/23 Updated: 2020/08/23 “A Local Motorcycle Girl’s Guide!
